title: Complete clock histories and a common spectral radius

results.claim: Every finite prime observation fibre is m+M_P Z; any infinite set of distinct primes separates the original integers.
results.programme_role: Makes the investigator's equal global-information requirement precise without assigning an infinite Frobenius weight.

results.scope: Full signed clock completion K=Zhat x Z/4
results.claim: All prime powers and the order-four branch survive; continuous characters have modulus one and signed characters separate the source.
results.programme_role: Exact common-modulus observation with no distance assigned to tau.

results.scope: Raw pullback on compact K; odd n>1
results.claim: U_n*=n V_n, U_n U_n*=nI, U_n*U_n=n E_n; norm sqrt(n).
results.programme_role: Computes all index and support-projection factors instead of inferring purity from a norm.

results.scope: Raw pullback D_n on X_n=(union n^-r Zhat) x Z/4, odd n>1
results.claim: D_n*D_n=D_n D_n*=nI; full spectrum is the circle of radius sqrt(n); no nonzero L2 eigenvectors.
results.programme_role: Explicit index-to-common-radius mechanism through retained backward history; not arithmetic cohomology or a zeta-zero identification.

results.scope: Compact-to-extended Hilbert map and original mirror
results.claim: Zero extension J is isometric; J*D_nJ=U_n and J*D_n^-1J=V_n. Original signed mirror commutes and every branch remains.
results.programme_role: Exact morphism explaining why the compact operator's eigenvalues differ from the extended spectrum without losing the original observation.

results.claim: Finite Haar image factor 1/n and real image factor n multiply to 1; the simultaneous raw pullback is unitary.
results.programme_role: Retains the archimedean factor and prevents the finite-place radius from being relabelled as the full arithmetic action.

human_sources.authors: Alain Connes; Matilde Marcolli; Niranjan Ramachandran

not_claimed: Derivation of the winding source from a bare point alone
An eigenvalue or cohomological realization of every Riemann zero
Permission to erase the prime-two clock data or extend the signed power map to even degree
